verdicts: VERDICT: DEMONSTRATED - 4,712 is not a multiple of 412, so it cannot be a balanced 412-hospital panel; expected 4532 (all years) or at most 4120 for models with Peer(t-1).
VERDICT: DEMONSTRATED - stars inconsistent with coefficient/SE (robust to rounding) in: Environmental uncertainty M3: 0.084 (0.051) printed ***, |t|=1.65, p=0.1003
VERDICT: DEMONSTRATED - the Model 2 peer estimate is not shown equivalent to zero (TOST p=0.243 at margin 0.069); its 95% CI reaches 0.117. Non-significance does not license 'rule out'.
VERDICT: REFUTED-BY-CHECK - the reported magnitudes (2.7 pp, about one-sixth SD, fall > two-thirds) are arithmetically correct.

VERDICT: DEMONSTRATED - under the manuscript's own relations, a modularity coefficient with no causal content survives the staffing control (positive, p<.05) in 100% of replications; survival cannot rule out capability confounding. The control also biases a true effect by -18%.
VERDICT: INCONCLUSIVE - the economizing-only DGP reproduces the Table 2 pattern in only 0.28 of replications with these parameters, so the comparison is not informative (p09:fnd:6, p09:fnd:7).

VERDICT: DEMONSTRATED - with no effect of modularity and same-year feedback from outsourcing to reported modularity, the within-hospital FE estimate is positive and significant in 100% of replications (mean 0.107); lagging m still gives 100%; 2SLS on state requirements gives mean 0.002 (a valid repair only if requirements satisfy exclusion, which ms does not argue).

VERDICT: DEMONSTRATED - part (a) of p09:fnd:9: with zero pre-trends and cohort-heterogeneous dynamic effects, TWFE event-study coefficients do not recover the true effects (or show non-zero leads): saturated rel -7: mean 0.0240 vs truth 0.0000; saturated rel -6: mean 0.0217 vs truth 0.0000; saturated rel -5: mean 0.0186 vs truth 0.0000; saturated rel -4: mean 0.0141 vs truth 0.0000; saturated rel -3: mean 0.0080 vs truth 0.0000; saturated rel 0: mean 0.0088 vs truth 0.0108; saturated rel 1: mean 0.0188 vs truth 0.0216; binned rel <=-5: mean 0.0249 vs truth 0.0000; binned rel -4: mean 0.0175 vs truth 0.0000; binned rel -3: mean 0.0113 vs truth 0.0000; binned rel -2: mean 0.0043 vs truth 0.0000; binned rel 0: mean 0.0081 vs truth 0.0108; binned rel 1: mean 0.0173 vs truth 0.0216; binned rel 2: mean 0.0280 vs truth 0.0324; binned rel >=5: mean 0.0947 vs truth 0.1065
VERDICT: DEMONSTRATED - p09:fnd:10: hospital-clustered SEs reject a true null for Peer at 56.0% (nominal 5%; state-clustered 31.7%).
VERDICT: DEMONSTRATED - p09:fnd:11: with persistent state shocks and no imitation, lagged Peer predicts own outsourcing (mean b = 0.270; significant in 100% with state clustering).
